Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 6 pack code 424RE.

The Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed, Fire-Rated LED Recessed Downlight provides safe, energy-efficient illumination for various indoor settings. Suitable for both domestic and commercial use, it is ideal for bathroom installations in Zone 1, kitchens, and corridors requiring robust, sealed lighting. This dimmable downlight emits a comfortable warm white 3000K light. Installation is straightforward and rapid, featuring a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, fitting perfectly into a standard 57mm cut-out. Its IP65 rating ensures superior protection against dust and water, and the integrated LED delivers a long 50,000-hour operational life.
